title: Vanishing Fourier coefficient off the perpendicular subspace
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a,\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ with $\gamma$ not perpendicular to $H$ under the standard dot product. The Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$ has absolute value zero.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
